title: Acceptance probability of a conjunction tester
statement: Let $T$ and $U$ be nonadaptive testers for functions from a domain to a codomain, using respectively $r$ and $s$ queries, and let $f$ be such a function. The tester that runs both testers with independent seeds and accepts exactly when both accept has acceptance probability on $f$ equal to the product of their individual acceptance probabilities.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester using $r$ queries
$U$ is a nonadaptive tester using $s$ queries
$f$ maps the common domain to the common codomain
